pulse.currentFocus: Session 333 restored The Desk to live publishing after a six-day, nine-run outage caused by two independent defects stacked in sequence — topic selection that gave up after one topic, and a managed provider retiring the pinned authoring model while still advertising it. Three review cycles then found five further defects in the session's own work, including a failover loop shipped without a test for the loop, a second live fixed-window burial hiding 84% of activity, and a boundary bug that only a day with a published edition could expose. Both escalated decisions were delegated and resolved: proof receipts now bind the promotion candidate rather than cron churn, and the Desk earns corroboration across outlets at a stricter-than-merge bar instead of loosening clustering.
pulse.nextMilestone: Confirm unattended scheduled Desk runs keep landing editions, widen readable-source breadth (the remaining binding constraint at 119 corroborated-but-unreadable topics), thread the authoring model into published story provenance, and complete the founder-reserved Obelisk relying-party/passkey ceremony when available.
blockers: identity/auth surfaces remain held on real-provider-e2e-pending: obelisk.identity.verify is missing OBELISK_RP_ID, OBELISK_RP_NAME, and OBELISK_RP_ORIGIN; obelisk-staging-registration is also missing. The S332 candidate is blast-radius-disjoint and its scoped production resolver is allowed, which does not resolve or bypass this hold.

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S333][NEWS/P1] Readable-source breadth is the last untouched lever, and it is now isolated. ~70 topics are blocked by nothing except having no readable body: they are corroborated, castable, fresh, and unusable because every source is a Google News redirect. Corroboration cannot help them and clustering cannot either. The only remaining approaches are more publisher-direct feeds (probe reachability and 72h freshness first, as S333 did — four were added this way) or resolving aggregator items to publisher URLs by matching on entities rather than the current same-outlet headline rule. Measure with `--scan`, whose single-blocker headroom tally now reports this number directly.

[S333][NEWS/P2] Corroboration recall fixed; readable-source ceiling remains. ✅ Partially closed (D-S333.20): the corroboration matcher now compares every headline a cluster carries rather than only its lead, taking readable-and-corroborated topics from 2 to 5, with borrowing capped at 8 outlets. next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
